standard_prerequisites.name: Divisors, invertible sheaves and the restriction map on the Picard group
standard_prerequisites.statement: For an integral normal scheme the divisors of meromorphic sections of invertible sheaves give the usual presentation of the Picard group, restriction of an invertible sheaf to an open subscheme is surjective for the schemes at hand here, and the divisor of a rational function determines that function up to a unit. The author's own definitions and the three lemmas of the Divisors chapter quoted inside the proof are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted exact sequence is the tool the whole section uses to move between divisors on the model, divisors on the curve and the components of the special fibre.

core_obligations: Surjectivity of the restriction map: the generic fibre is an open subscheme of the model, so every invertible sheaf on the curve extends to one on the model, which is the first quoted lemma of the Divisors chapter (source lines 4661-4663).

Identify the kernel: take an invertible sheaf on the model whose restriction to the curve is trivial, choose the resulting meromorphic section and write its divisor as an integral combination of the components of the special fibre (source lines 4664-4670).

Use normality to invert the construction: by the quoted description of the kernel of the divisor class map on a normal scheme the sheaf is the one attached to that combination, so every element of the kernel is attached to the special fibre (source lines 4671-4673).

Compute which combinations are actually trivial: if the sheaf attached to a combination is trivial then the combination is the divisor of a rational function which is regular and invertible on the generic fibre, hence a unit times a power of the uniformizer, so the combination is an integral multiple of the special fibre, written with the multiplicities (source lines 4674-4681).

proof_roadmap.step: Surjectivity of restriction to the generic fibre.
Write the divisor of a meromorphic section as a combination of the components.
Invert the divisor of a section construction using normality.
Show the trivial combinations are exactly the integral multiples of the special fibre and close the exact sequence.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-regular-model-pic（源 4649-4658 行，证明 4660-4681 行）：在正则模型情形下有正合列 0→Z→Z^⊕n→Pic(X)→Pic(C)→0，其中第一个映射把 1 送到 (m_1,…,m_n)、第二个把第 i 个基向量送到 O_X(C_i)。关键操作不是例行核验：满射性来自「C 是 X 的开子概型、可逆层可延拓」（4661-4663 行）；核的刻画要把「限制到 C 上平凡」的可逆层取一个亚纯截面、把其除子写成 Σ a_i C_i（4664-4670 行），再用正规性下的除子类映射单射性反推出 L=O_X(Σ a_i C_i)（4671-4673 行）；最后一步必须把「O_X(Σ a_i C_i) 平凡」翻译成「存在函子域元素 g 其除子等于该组合」，并证明 g 在一般纤维上无零点无极点、从而 g=π^a u、于是该组合恰是 aΣm_iC_i（4674-4681 行）。难点在于四个环节分别依赖除子论的三条不同结论，且要把「核」同时用除子和函数两种语言刻画；原文位置在证明的 4661-4663、4664-4670、4671-4673、4674-4681 行。
